correctness.rationale: Exact bijection: each ternary-power part occurs 0,1,2 times and its digits combine into unrestricted ones; reverse unique base-three expansion. Every n has P(n)=sum_{j<=n} B(j). B(1)=B(3)=0; every n>=2 except 3 has a singleton witness or, for n a positive 3-power at least 9, (2,n-2). Boundaries n=0,1,2,3 explicitly covered. Checker passed n<=512 and 5000 carries.
